findings.assessment: The successful restore reads current dataset revision and asserts it is exactly 2, then submits that revision. The later stale retry still submits 1 and requires 409. Private C08 metadata preservation, source incarnation replacement, old reference denial, roles/access protection and export assertions remain.

findings.diagnosis: The prior fixture declared annual budget zero and only November forecast 40000. Eleven missing forecast entries cause estimated budget fallback; canonical coverage requires confirmed components, so total null was correct for that source.

No product qualifier, financial formula, permission or coverage assertion is relaxed. New pre-BI assertions require a source-only request, all twelve confirmed training components and the complete canonical 250000 result.
